readables.title: SUBLEVEL IX — THE VESSEL CHAMBER
readables.stamp: RECORD VERIFIED. THE RECORD VERIFIES ITSELF.
readables.margin: nothing here is born. things are issued.
readables.obs: the stone is older than the chamber. the chamber was built around it.

readables.title: CRADLE ROSTER — THIS WALL
readables.margin: the ink of the earlier entries has gone grey. like ash got into it.
readables.obs: there is room on the wall for many more entries. the chisel is still here.

readables.title: ASCENT SHAFT — GATE 9
readables.stamp: THE CITY IS WAITING, AS IT ALWAYS DOES.
readables.obs: the worn side of the stone faces down, toward the cradles. many have passed. none have returned this way.

readables.title: THE FIRST FUNDAMENTAL
readables.stamp: LAW: EXISTENCE REQUIRES A REGISTERED PURPOSE.
readables.margin: purpose precedes creation. the city carves this where children can see it.
readables.obs: the letters are deep enough to last centuries. someone checks them weekly.

readables.title: PROCESSION STREET — LOWER WALK
readables.margin: everyone walks alone. the sign means something older.
readables.obs: the stone has been re-cut twice. both times the words came back smaller.

readables.title: ANCHOR — STATION 12 OF 12
readables.stamp: BOTH SENTENCES ARE TRUE. FILE UNDER: MERCY.
readables.obs: the plate was cast whole. nobody chose which sentence came first.

readables.title: THE SECOND FUNDAMENTAL
readables.stamp: LAW: AUDITS ARE MANDATORY AND PERIODIC.
readables.margin: the measurers witness worth. so it is written; so it is paid.
readables.obs: posted law, civic grade. the same text hangs in the chapel in gold.

readables.title: THE ASH QUARTER — WARD 3
readables.margin: the sweepers are paid in bread. the bread is paid in ash. nobody has traced where the ash is paid from.
readables.obs: the ward number is newer than the stone. the stone is newer than the street.

readables.title: TOLL GATE 03 — TARIFF OF DEBTS
readables.stamp: DEBTS DO NOT LAPSE. DEBTS DO NOT FORGIVE. THE GATE REMEMBERS.
readables.obs: the tariff has been amended so many times the amendments have amendments.

readables.title: NOTICE — RECARVING DAY
body: THE CENSUS STONES REQUIRE RECARVING MORE OFTEN THIS YEAR.
THE MEASURERS THANK YOU FOR YOUR DEFINITION.
readables.margin: the recarvers say the names come back shallower each time. the recarvers are not supposed to say.
readables.obs: the notice is nailed over an older notice. the older notice is nailed over an older notice.

readables.title: SCRATCHED LOW ON THE WALL
readables.margin: a small hand. the letters are careful, like school was recent. or a long time ago.
readables.obs: scratched with something harder than devotion.

readables.title: THE THIRD FUNDAMENTAL
readables.margin: the censored were never worthy. the ash gets everywhere.
readables.obs: the board is bolted shut. the law is not meant to be taken down.

readables.title: WARD 3 — INHABITANTS
readables.stamp: FOUR OF THE ABOVE HAVE BEEN STRUCK. THE STRIKING HAND IS VERY STEADY.
readables.margin: it looks like prayer, if you watch it being done.
readables.obs: the struck names are shallower than the living ones. give it a year.

readables.title: THE THIRD ENUMERATION
readables.stamp: THE SEAL IS INTACT. THE INTACTNESS IS NOTARIZED.
readables.obs: the wax is the color of the doors. everything official here is the color of the doors.

readables.title: THE FOURTH FUNDAMENTAL
readables.stamp: LAW: CONSENSUS DATA OUTWEIGHS SINGLE RECORDS.
readables.margin: collective faith creates saints. she is listening.
readables.obs: gold leaf, chapel grade. the civic copy on process street is painted wood.

readables.title: THE PALE SAINT — VERSICLES
body: Her skin is the color of the first page.
She holds what the forgotten remember.
readables.margin: before her there was no one to pray to. so they prayed, and there was.
readables.obs: the ink was mixed by four hands. three are known. the fourth is older than the chapel.

readables.title: HYMN — THE COUNTING
body: we are counted, we are kept,
the ash falls where the unnamed slept;
readables.margin: the children sing it faster than the bells. the bells do not mind.
readables.obs: hymn 9 of 11. the other ten are less honest.

readables.title: SCRATCHED BEHIND THE RELIQUARY
body: that is how it works here.
readables.obs: four sentences. the last one was added later, in a calmer hand.

readables.title: RECORD HALL A — FAILED ATTEMPTS
readables.obs: the wear is on the right side, where the last digit would be. no one will ever know how many.

readables.title: RECORD — ENTITY_000_771
body: MEMORIAL NOTE: she asked what the ash was.
the record does not say if anyone answered.
readables.obs: the page is loose because 770 pages before it were pulled, read, and put back wrong.

readables.title: IN THE MARGIN, A DIFFERENT HAND
body: i am the margin they were written in.
readables.obs: no record of who wrote this. the ink refuses to fade. the archive has noticed and elected not to act.

readables.title: NOTICE — MURAL, CHANTY WALL
body: THE MURAL HAS BEEN CORRECTED BY HAND.
THE HAND IS NO LONGER EMPLOYED HERE.
readables.stamp: THE COUNT REMAINS DISPUTED. THE COUNT REMAINS OFFICIAL.
readables.obs: the notice is dated. the date is not in any calendar the archive keeps.

readables.title: THE FIFTH FUNDAMENTAL — GANTRY ENTRANCE
readables.margin: correction is mercy. it is not punishment. it is not punishment.
readables.obs: stenciled, industrial grade. down here the fundamentals stop being carved and start being sprayed.

readables.title: MAINTENANCE LOG 7-04
body: ENTRY, DAY [WORN]: the heart beat out of sequence. the sequence was amended. the heart was not consulted.
readables.obs: the log has one author. the author has been dead for a long time. the author's shifts continue.

readables.title: WARNING — HEART APPROACH
body: DO NOT LOOK AT THE HEART
readables.margin: the paint is fresh. someone re-stenciled it recently. someone always re-stencils it.
readables.obs: the stencil has been renewed so many times the wall underneath has gone smooth.

readables.title: GANTRY 7-4 — WATCHER ALLOCATION
readables.stamp: THE DESIGN WATCHES BACK. FILE UNDER: ARCHITECTURE.
readables.obs: the wear is exactly where the current number would be. it was never meant to be permanent.

readables.title: SCRATCHED AT FLOOR LEVEL
readables.margin: left by hands that came in the night. the measurers sand it off. the hands come back.
readables.obs: the grooves are deep. whoever made them was in no hurry to leave.

readables.title: THE MONUMENT — BASE INSCRIPTION
readables.obs: the chains are load-bearing. the inscription is not.

readables.title: OFFERINGS — ACCEPTED
readables.stamp: THE DESIGN ACCEPTS ALL THREE AT EQUAL RATE.
readables.margin: the teeth are the honest ones.
readables.obs: the plate is bronze. the braziers are iron. the difference is a question of rank.

readables.title: THE SURFACE
readables.margin: the stone is blank all the way through. the carvers checked.
readables.obs: a blank stele, hauled up and set upright by no recorded hand. the wind does not file reports.

readables.title: SCRATCHED BY NO KNOWN HAND
readables.obs: the letters face the sky, not the street. they were written last. they were written first.
